bugs.title: Vertical ad creative is cropped instead of displayed with FIT
bugs.symptom: Ad video sizing and positioning previously cropped or misplaced sponsored creatives instead of centering the complete frame in the browser viewport.
affected_examples: Jon Phillips Silverback Management sponsored video
working_comparisons: Verified full ad media centered in the browser viewport with balanced black space around fitted creative
bugs.root_cause: Nested ad media geometry and centering rule order allowed the fitted video box to resolve against the wrong origin. One pass also applied inset:auto after left/top, erasing the intended centering coordinates.
bugs.fix_summary: The dedicated Ads FIT guard sizes from intrinsic media dimensions, uses the browser viewport as the positioning reference, applies inset before the 50vw/50vh coordinates, and centers with translate(-50%, -50%). User verified the live result.
bugs.future_repair: Keep ad media sizing and positioning isolated from normal VEC video geometry.

bugs.title: Ads CMS break cadence is ignored and ads play every other song
bugs.symptom: The player appeared to ignore an every-song ad instruction and play commercials every other song.
affected_examples: DEV V2 desktop live sequence on 2026-08-21
working_comparisons: Player follows the saved Ads CMS break_interval value
bugs.root_cause: Final user verification found the Ads CMS controller itself had remained set to every other song during the test. The player behavior matched the saved controller setting.
bugs.fix_summary: The CMS remains the cadence source of truth. Earlier cadence hardening remains in place, and the user verified the issue should be closed after confirming the controller setting.
bugs.future_repair: Compare the live public break_interval with the saved Ads CMS selection before diagnosing a cadence mismatch.
